columns.keyspace: Total number of candidate passwords hashcat will try for this job (hashcat's 'keyspace').
columns.agents: Number of cracking agents (machines) currently assigned to this job, not browser user-agents.

row.rulesLabel: Suffix appended after a count to show it already includes the rules multiplier, e.g. '500 (rules)'.

common.rulesMultiplier: Suffix appended after a count to show it already includes the rules multiplier, e.g. '500 (rules)'.

details.incrementMode: Hashcat's increment mode: tries masks across a range of password lengths instead of one fixed length.
details.incrementRange: The minimum-to-maximum password-length range used by increment mode.
details.associationHints: Data for hashcat's association attack: pairs each hash with one specific candidate (e.g. a username-keyed wordlist line).
details.splittingMode: How this job's keyspace is divided into dispatchable chunks across agents.
details.additionalArgs: Extra raw hashcat command-line flags appended to this job's attack.

layerTable.effectiveKeyspace: This layer's keyspace after being self-healed/corrected from real hashcat progress, as opposed to the initial estimate.

cloudBurst.badge: Indicates this job is allowed to rent cloud GPU instances when the on-prem fleet is busy.
cloudBurst.thirdPartyBadge: Indicates the rented instance comes from an external cloud provider, not the organization's own hardware.

scope.global: The agent is blocklisted for this hash type/mode across ALL jobs, not just the current one.

columns.hashMode: The hash type + attack mode combination this benchmark-failure blocklist entry applies to.

columns.original: Label shown in the Round column for round 0 — the original attack job, before any loopback rounds.
columns.loopsBack: Whether this job's cracked results will themselves be re-run next round, or only feed the next round's delta wordlist.

loopback.loopsBackFeedsDelta: Shown when this job's cracks are only used to build the next loopback round's delta wordlist, without this job itself looping again.
